body:
I have been suffering from axiety all my life. In 03 I finally found a doctor that would prescribe it for me. Ever since I started taking it I've noticed that sometimes I feel 100% better. I can go on about my life like a normal person. Thanks to reputable harm reduction websites
for allowing me to share my experience. It's also an ok recreation drug. Right now I'm only on 4 mg and I feel totally at peace. I feel light headed(which I like) and I no longer care about the petty things that normally bother me. I hope this review will help someone. Klonopin is a very helpful drug.
Thanks for letting me share.
